claim_scope: Pinned-runtime reproduction on the existing synthetic three-turn smoke; not a holdout or equivalence result.

runs.critical_failure: initial all-years chart collapsed duplicate district rows because the plan omitted the year series

runs.status: failed on hosted planner timeout during turn 3

harness_fixes: derive oracle metric names from the validated percent operation rather than a hard-coded alias list
reject chart plans whose x/series fields do not uniquely identify result rows
record planner and critic transport failures separately without stale attempt data
remove row, null and distinct counts as well as values from frontier critic profiles
decision: The pinned harness is reproducible and the generic chart invariant repaired the observed semantic visual fault. OpenRouter Qwen 27B latency remains an event risk and does not replace local replay.
